summary: Derive the frequency ladder and fixed seed, then solve a signed complex Ronnmark kx root at every frequency.

identity.relation: SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to signed complex kx roots
identity.direction: SI equilibrium controls and dimensionless ladder bounds to signed complex kx roots
identity.definition: The graph derives its ordered frequency ladder from wn and a single kx_start=kx_scale*kn; the bounded root solver repeats that seed independently at every frequency.
identity.coordinates: complex perpendicular wavenumber plane; kz is an absolute input
identity.boundary: zero kz is allowed; roots retain sign and nonpositive exit flags remain observable
assumptions: All species controls describe one shared equilibrium snapshot.

inputs.name: ms
inputs.description: 各组分质量，进入热速度与回旋频率
inputs.constraints: Finite positive masses, one value per species.

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: 各组分电荷，决定回旋频率符号
inputs.constraints: Finite nonzero charges, one value per species.

inputs.name: ns_unit
inputs.description: 各组分密度相对参考密度的倍数
inputs.constraints: Finite positive density ratios matching the species axis.

inputs.name: Ts_unit
inputs.description: 各组分温度相对参考温度的倍数
inputs.constraints: Finite positive temperature ratios matching the species axis.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: 背景磁场强度，标定回旋频率尺度

inputs.name: T00
inputs.constraints: Finite positive reference temperature in eV.

inputs.name: omega_scale
inputs.description: 扫描频率阶梯的起点倍数，乘以 wn 得到首个角频率
inputs.constraints: Finite scan start; every derived angular frequency must be nonzero.

inputs.name: omega_step
inputs.description: 扫描频率阶梯的步长倍数，乘以 wn 得到相邻频点间隔；源码两处扫描均取 0.05

inputs.name: omega_stop
inputs.description: 扫描频率阶梯的终点倍数（源码 3.95），与起点、步长一起写定源码的冒号表达式，阶梯点数即由此导出
inputs.constraints: Finite scan endpoint not below the start.

inputs.name: kz
inputs.description: 平行波数绝对值，即源码驱动写定的 kz（算例 1 为 2*5.0、算例 2 为 0.0），进入平行共振宗量；调用方直接给出物理控制量，不由任何参考波数换算
inputs.constraints: Finite absolute parallel wavenumber; zero is supported by the kinetic paths.

inputs.name: kx_scale
inputs.description: 各频点共用的复初值相对 kn 的比例；源码固定为 0.6 且不做频点间延续

inputs.name: tol_fun
inputs.description: 对应 Octave TolFun 的残差相对收敛阈值

inputs.name: tol_x
inputs.description: 对应 Octave Tolx 的变量相对步长收敛阈值

inputs.name: max_iterations
inputs.description: 对应 Octave MaxIter 的每个频点最大迭代次数

inputs.name: max_function_evals
inputs.description: 对应 Octave MaxFunEvals 的每个频点最大目标函数求值次数

outputs.name: scales
outputs.description: 由平衡输入导出的逐组分尺度，供波数标定与求根共用
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kz
outputs.description: 本次扫描实际使用的平行波数，直接取自调用方的绝对控制量
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: 由源码冒号阶梯 (omega_scale:omega_step:omega_stop) 导出的频点个数
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: omegas
outputs.description: 本次扫描实际使用的角频率序列
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: kx_start
outputs.description: 延续求根的起始复初值
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: roots
outputs.description: 逐频点求得的复垂直波数根
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: residuals
outputs.description: 各根处的色散行列式残差
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: determinant_scale
outputs.description: 各根处介电张量元素的模最大值，作为残差抵消量级的基准
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: exit_flags
outputs.description: 各频点的 Octave fsolve 退出标志，取值限于 {1,2,3,0,-2,-3}
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.description: 各频点实际使用的迭代次数
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: function_evals
outputs.description: 各频点实际的目标函数求值次数
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: 各频点退出标志是否为正，即 Octave 是否判定收敛
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: solver
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

outputs.name: graph_order
outputs.description: 本图的固定执行顺序标签
outputs.constraints: The returned value follows the stated shape and physical normalization.

preconditions: zero kz is allowed; roots retain sign and nonpositive exit flags remain observable
supported: Derive the frequency ladder and fixed seed, then solve a signed complex Ronnmark kx root at every frequency.
excluded: No unrequested mode identity or accuracy guarantee is inferred.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: The first invalid graph control or dependency input raises ValueError; no partial result mapping is returned.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency numerical errors propagate without fallback; solver diagnostics remain observable where returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Root exit flags remain in the result.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception.
